short_description: VPN connection fails with error 691 on Windows
close_notes: User's cached AD credentials were stale after password rotation. Signed out, cleared Windows Credential Manager entries for the VPN host, signed back in with new password. Connection restored.

short_description: GlobalProtect VPN client rejects server certificate
close_notes: Root CA was missing from the machine trust store after imaging. Pushed corporate root cert via SCCM. VPN handshake succeeded on retry.

short_description: User cannot log in after replacing mobile phone, MFA token gone
close_notes: Verified identity via manager, reset MFA enrollment in Okta admin, walked user through re-enrolling authenticator app on new device.

short_description: MFA codes rejected as invalid despite entering correctly
close_notes: Phone system clock had drifted more than 60 seconds. Enabled automatic time on device, TOTP codes accepted immediately.

short_description: Outlook stuck in Working Offline mode, will not reconnect
close_notes: Outlook cached mode profile corrupted. Rebuilt OST file, disabled and re-enabled Cached Exchange Mode. Mail flow resumed.

short_description: Shared calendar not visible in Outlook after permission grant
close_notes: Calendar cache in Outlook did not refresh. Removed the shared calendar, waited 15 minutes for AD replication, re-added it. Events appeared.

short_description: Network printer shows offline in Windows despite being powered on
close_notes: Print spooler service had hung. Restarted Print Spooler, cleared queue, printer came back online without needing driver reinstall.

short_description: Printing produces garbled output on HP LaserJet
close_notes: Wrong universal print driver installed. Removed driver, installed the model-specific PCL6 driver from HP support site. Test page printed correctly.

short_description: Laptop takes over 10 minutes to reach desktop after login
close_notes: Roaming profile size exceeded 2GB due to large OneDrive cache. Excluded OneDrive from roaming profile sync, capped profile at 500MB. Login time under 90 seconds.

short_description: Recurring BSOD on Dell laptop, DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION
close_notes: Intel storage driver was outdated and incompatible with recent Windows update. Updated Intel RST driver via Dell Command Update. No further crashes over 7 days.

short_description: Slack desktop app not showing notifications on macOS
close_notes: macOS notification permissions revoked after OS upgrade. Opened System Settings > Notifications, re-enabled alerts for Slack, toggled Do Not Disturb off. Notifications restored.

short_description: Cannot push to GitHub, permission denied publickey
close_notes: SSH agent was not running and key was not loaded. Started ssh-agent, added key with ssh-add, verified with ssh -T git@github.com. Push succeeded.

short_description: Laptop cannot connect to corporate wifi, authentication failed
close_notes: 802.1X profile pushed by GPO conflicted with a manually saved profile. Deleted the manual profile, forced a group policy update, reconnected using the managed profile.

short_description: Citrix VDI session shows black screen after login
close_notes: GPU driver mismatch on the VDI host after a maintenance window. Rebooted the affected VDA server, session redirected to a healthy host and rendered normally.

short_description: Application server C drive at 100 percent, services crashing
close_notes: Old IIS log files consuming 40GB in C:\inetpub\logs. Enabled log rotation policy, archived old logs to secondary volume, freed 38GB. Services restarted cleanly.
